## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Minted SR-71 BlackGlider from the canonical RSR template for the
  Metadatastician estate.
- Established the uncompromised single-world B3/S23 mathematical contract.
- Added a Rust reference kernel with exhaustive 512-case local-rule coverage.
- Added a genuine Snark reflection, causal counterfactual, exact rotated chart,
  and presentation non-interference gates.
- Added canonical replay and reaction certificates, an independent exhaustive
  4-by-4 transition oracle, complete glider heading/phase coverage, finite-rim
  causal checks, and an exact parity-preserving chart.
- Added a gated, axiom-free Idris2 constitutional companion and made it part of
  `just test`.
- Documented the proof frontier: what is established before gameplay, what can
  still be proved abstractly, and which next obligations require a frozen
  finite mission.
- Assigned the maintainer-selected primary clade `fv` — Formal Verification &
  Proofs.

### Fixed

- Rescued the repository from an uncommitted working tree (2026-08-03):
  reconciled stray worktree copies, filled PROOF-STATUS and READINESS from
  measured gate runs, and removed template residue.
